HELPFRAME_STUCK_TEXT1.source:
If you find yourself stuck and unable to move, please try the auto-unstuck feature prior to petitioning a GM. In most cases, this should solve the problem. Activating the auto-unstuck command will first attempt to use your hearthstone to port you back to your inn. If this is not possible, it will attempt to nudge your character out of position.

Please note this option can only be used every 5 minutes. Using the auto-unstuck option will log your character and location so that we can verify and fix the location in the future.
HELPFRAME_STUCK_TEXT1.target:
若卡住無法移動，請先使用自動脫困，再向GM求助，通常即可解決。自動脫困會先嘗試使用爐石傳回旅店；若不可行，則嘗試稍微移動角色。

此功能每5分鐘只能使用一次，並會記錄角色與位置，供日後確認及修正該地點。

MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE4.source: - To cast a spell from a macro use the following syntax:  /cast <name> (<subtext>)
MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE4.target: - 使用巨集指令施放法術的語法:/cast <法術名稱>(<臺詞>)

MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE5.source: - Shift click a spell in your spellbook with the macro UI open to add it to your macro
MACRO_HELP_TEXT_LINE5.target: - 在已打開巨集指令介面的情況下按住Shift點擊法術書中的法術可將此法術添加到你的巨集指令裡

MACRO_POPUP_TEXT.target: 輸入巨集的名稱(最多16個字元):

MAGE_INTELLECT_TOOLTIP.source:
Increases mana points and chance to score a critical hit with spells.
Increases the rate at which weapon skills improve.
MAGE_INTELLECT_TOOLTIP.target:
提高法力上限和法術造成致命一擊的機率。
提高武器技能熟練度的提升速度。

MAIL_COD_ERROR.target: 付款取信郵件的金額不得超過%d

MAIL_LETTER_TOOLTIP.source:
Click to make a permanent
copy of this letter.
MAIL_LETTER_TOOLTIP.target:
點擊這裡來獲得一份這封信
永久性的副本。

MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_TOOLTIP.source: Increases damage with melee weapons by %.1f damage per second.
MELEE_ATTACK_POWER_TOOLTIP.target: 使近戰武器的每秒傷害提高%.1f點。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ABANDONQUEST.source: Abandons the selected quest, removing it from the Quest Log. Any quest that you abandon can be accepted again at some later date. Associated quest items will remain in your inventory, and there is no penalty for abandoning a quest.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ABANDONQUEST.target: 放棄選取的任務，並將其從任務日誌移除。放棄的任務日後仍可重新接受，相關任務物品會留在背包中；放棄任務不會受到懲罰。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDFRIEND.source: Adds a player to your friends list. You will be notified whenever a friend logs on or off. Other players do not know whether they are on your friends list.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDFRIEND.target: 將一個玩家添加到你的好友名單中。當該玩家登入或者退出遊戲的時候，你會收到相應的提示。其他玩家不會知道他們是否在你的好友名單之上。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ADDMEMBER.source: Adds a new player to the guild.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ALLIANCE.source: A proud member of the Alliance, opposed to members of the Horde (Orcs, Trolls, Tauren, Undead).
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ALLIANCE.target: 身為聯盟的一員，你與部落成員（獸人、食人妖、牛頭人、不死族）處於敵對關係。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELDMINIMAP_OPTION.source: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELDMINIMAP_OPTION.target: 滑鼠右鍵點擊以打開此視窗的自定義選項列表。滑鼠左鍵點擊並拖曳來移動這個視窗。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELD_GROUP_JOIN.source: If you are the leader of a group, this button will add your current group to the battleground queue. Your group will be guaranteed to get into the same battleground instance at the same time.  Any group member added after you click this button or a group member in a queue for another battleground will not be guaranteed entrance to the same battleground.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_BATTLEFIELD_GROUP_JOIN.target: 如果你是一個小隊的隊長，這個按鈕可以將你的整個小隊一起加入戰場等待佇列，並保證你的小隊同時進入同一個戰場副本。但是，如果你在此之後添加新的隊員，或者某個隊員正在其他戰場的等待佇列中，那麼他們也許無法和你進入同一個戰場。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHARACTER.source: Information about your character, including equipment, statistics, skills, and reputation.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHARACTER.target: 你的角色資訊，包括裝備、屬性、技能與聲望。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATMENU.source: Commands used for communicating with others. With the Chat menu, you can talk to people standing nearby, send a private message to one person, chat with party members, wave at a friend, or create a macro.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATMENU.target: 用來跟別人溝通的指令。使用對話功能表，你可以和周圍的玩家交談，可以傳送私人訊息給某個人，或者和隊伍成員聊天，和一個朋友揮手致意或者建立一個巨集指令。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATOPTIONS.source: Right-click to get a list of customizable options for this window. Left-click and drag to move the window.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_CHATOPTIONS.target: 右鍵點擊獲得這個視窗的自定義選項列表。左鍵點擊拖曳來移動這個視窗。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DEMOTE.source: Demotes the selected player one rank lower.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DEMOTE.target: 降低所選擇玩家在公會中的會階。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DISHONORABLE_KILLS.source: Each time you assist in killing a civilian in PvP that is too low of a level to give you experience (a gray level number), you will get a dishonorable kill.   Each dishonorable kill you get immediately reduces your overall ranking slightly, and each additional dishonorable kill you get during a single day has a larger effect than the last one.   Dishonorable kills are directly applied to your ranking.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_DISHONORABLE_KILLS.target: 每當你在PvP中協助或主動殺死了一個等級過低(對你來說是灰色)的平民，則你獲得一個非榮譽擊殺。每次非榮譽擊殺都會立刻稍稍降低你的總體排名，而非榮譽擊殺的次數越多，每次遭受的懲罰也越嚴重。非榮譽擊殺直接影響你的排名。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENCHANTSLOT.source: Drop an item into this slot to permit other players to unlock a container, or enchant or poison an item. An item placed in this slot will not be traded; rather, it will simply return to its owner's inventory.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENCHANTSLOT.target: 將物品放入這個空格中可以讓其他玩家進行開鎖、附魔或淬毒。放在這裡的物品不會被交易，在交易結束之後，它會回到原擁有者的物品欄中。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENTER_BATTLEGROUND.source: Join the queue to enter this battleground when space becomes available.  This will result in a longer wait than selecting "First Available".
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_ENTER_BATTLEGROUND.target: 加入這個戰場的等待佇列，當該戰場中有空位時即可進入。等待時間將比選擇「優先進入」戰場要長一些。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FIRST_AVAILABLE.source: Join the queue to enter the first available battleground. If you select "First Available" and another party member enters a "First Available" battleground, then your preference will be changed to that battleground.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FIRST_AVAILABLE.target: 加入優先進入的戰場等待佇列。如果你選擇了「優先進入」，而另一個隊友已經進入了「優先進入」的戰場，那麼你的首選戰場將被改為這個戰場。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FRIENDSTAB.source: Allows you to manage a list of players you enjoy playing with. You receive notifications of friends logging on or off.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_FRIENDSTAB.target: 編輯你比較樂意一起遊戲的玩家的名單。你可以收到這些玩家上線和下線的提示。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GROUPINVITE.source: Invites the selected player to join a group.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GROUPINVITE.target: 邀請選擇的玩家加入隊伍。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDCONTROL.source: Allows you to customize the names of each rank in your guild, along with its privileges.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDCONTROL.target: 自訂公會階級名稱和它們的權限。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDGROUPINVITE.source: Invites the selected guild member to join a group.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDGROUPINVITE.target: 邀請選擇的公會成員加入隊伍。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDPUBLICNOTE.source: Click to view your public note. This is information that other players will see about you in the guild UI. If you click on the note itself, you will be able to edit it.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDPUBLICNOTE.target: 點擊檢視你的公開註記。這個註記是別人通過公會使用者介面可以檢視到的。如果你點擊這條註記，那你就可以對其進行編輯。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDREMOVE.source: Removes the selected player from the guild.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDREMOVE.target: 將選定的玩家移除公會。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDTAB.source: Allows you to view information about your guild, and players in it. If you are an officer, you can also manage your guild from this tab.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILDTAB.target: 檢視關於你所在的公會及其會員的資訊。如果你是公會的幹部，還可以在這個視窗中進行公會管理工作。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILD_MEMBER_OPTIONS.source: Right-click a guild member for more options.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_GUILD_MEMBER_OPTIONS.target: 在公會會員身上點選右鍵以獲得更多選項。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HEALTHBAR.source: The amount of health you currently have. If your health reaches zero, you will die. Health automatically regenerates when you are out of combat.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HEALTHBAR.target: 你目前擁有的生命值。生命值歸零時角色就會死亡；脫離戰鬥後，生命值會自動恢復。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HELP.source: Through this menu, you can report a bug. You can also use the Help Request menu to talk to one of our Game Masters (GMs) in the game if you have questions or need assistance.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HELP.target: 你可以透過此選單回報錯誤。若有疑問或需要協助，也可使用求助選單與遊戲管理員（GM）聯絡。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONORABLE_KILLS.source: Each time you or a group you are part of does damage to an enemy player in PvP that is subsequently killed you gain an honorable kill.   You only get an honorable kill if the target’s difficulty is green or better (the target would give you experience if it were a monster).    Only enemy players give honorable kills.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONORABLE_KILLS.target: 每當你或你所在的隊伍在PvP中對一個敵方玩家造成傷害，並且該玩家隨後被殺死，則你可以獲得一次榮譽擊殺。只有在目標等級對你來說是綠色或更高(若目標為怪物，則會使你獲得經驗值)的情況下才能獲得榮譽擊殺。只有敵方玩家會提供榮譽擊殺。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_CONTRIBUTION_POINTS.source: Honor is what you gain by making honorable kills in PvP combat.   How much honor you gain per kill is determined by how much damage you (or your group) did to the player that was killed, with more damage done equaling more honor.   This honor gain is split amongst the members of your group or raid group.   Also you will gain less honor for killing the same player over and over again in a short period of time, so after a few kills of the same player you will get little or no honor from killing them.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_CONTRIBUTION_POINTS.target: 榮譽點數是通過在PvP戰鬥中進行榮譽擊殺獲得的。殺死敵方玩家可以獲得多少點數取決於你(或你所在的隊伍)對其造成了多少傷害，並由你所在的小隊或團隊均分。如果你在短時間內反覆殺死同一個敵方玩家，則每次殺死他所獲得的榮譽點數也會越來越少，因此，在數次殺死同一個敵方玩家之後，你將獲得極少的榮譽點數，甚至不再獲得任何榮譽點數。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_STANDING.source: Standing is how you are doing compared to all other players on your side (Horde or Alliance).   If your standing is 150, then there were 149 players who gained more honor than you did during that time period. You must get at least 25 Honorable Kills in a week in order to be eligible to gain Standing and Rank.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HONOR_STANDING.target: 排名是根據你與其他同陣營的玩家(聯盟或部落)的相對表現排出的。如果你的排名是150，那就是說有149名玩家在同一時期獲得的榮譽點數比你多。你在一週中至少須累積25次榮譽擊殺，才有資格獲得排名和級別。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HORDE.source: A proud member of the Horde, opposed to members of the Alliance (Night Elves, Dwarves, Humans, Gnomes).
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_HORDE.target: 身為部落的一員，你與聯盟成員（夜精靈、矮人、人類、地精）處於敵對關係。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNOREPLAYER.source: Adds a player to your ignore list. You will no longer see messages or other text from players on your ignore list, nor will these players be able to communicate with you in any other way.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNOREPLAYER.target: 將一名玩家列入你的忽略名單中。你將不會收到忽略名單上玩家的訊息或其他文字，被忽略的玩家也無法透過任何方式與你聯絡。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNORETAB.source: Allows you to modify the list of players whom you are currently ignoring.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_IGNORETAB.target: 編輯你目前忽略中的玩家名單。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LATENCY.source: The average time it takes to talk with the game server. A low latency will display as a green bar, higher latencies will be yellow or even red. Consistently high latencies may indicate a problem with your Internet connection.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_LATENCY.target: 與遊戲伺服器通訊所需的平均時間。低延遲顯示為綠色，較高延遲則為黃色或紅色；持續高延遲可能表示網路連線有問題。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MAINMENU.source: Here you can modify your video, sound, and interface settings, or create custom hotkeys. You can also choose to log out or exit the program altogether.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MAINMENU.target: 在此調整畫面、音效與介面設定，或自訂快捷鍵。你也可以登出或離開遊戲。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR0.source: The amount of mana you currently have. Players require mana in order to cast spells. Mana automatically regenerates if you have not cast a spell in the past five seconds.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR0.target: 你目前擁有的法力。施放法術需要消耗法力；若過去五秒內沒有施法，法力就會自動恢復。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR1.source: Warrior abilities require Rage. Rage is gained when you cause damage or take damage.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR1.target: 戰士使用技能需要怒氣；造成或承受傷害時都會獲得怒氣。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR2.source: Hunters require focus to use their abilities.  Focus generates while standing still.

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR3.source: Rogues require energy in order to use their abilities. Energy constantly regenerates.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR3.target: 盜賊使用技能需要能量，能量會持續恢復。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR4.source: The amount of happiness your pet currently has. Content pets inflict normal damage on their enemies, whereas Happy pets inflict enhanced damage, and unhappy pets inflict reduced damage. Happiness goes down when your pet dies or as it grows hungry, while feeding your pet will increase its happiness.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_MANABAR4.target: 你寵物現在的快樂值。讓你的寵物感到滿足會讓它對敵人造成普通傷害，而高興狀態下的寵物會製造更多的傷害，而不高興狀態下的寵物製造的傷害會減少。當你的寵物死亡或者呈現飢餓狀態的時候會降低快樂值，而餵食你的寵物能增加它的快樂值。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PARTYOPTIONS.source: If you belong to a party, you can right-click your portrait to bring up the Party Options menu. This menu will allow you to quit the party or see what looting rules the party is using. A party leader can add or remove party members, as well as change the party's looting rules.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PARTYOPTIONS.target: 如果你在一個隊伍裡，可以用右鍵點擊你的頭像來打開小隊功能選單。這個選單可以讓你退出隊伍或者查看現在使用的物品拾取方式。小隊的隊長可以增加或者移除隊員，並可以改變物品拾取方式。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PLAYEROPTIONS.source: Right-click to bring up special commands for interacting with another player. You can inspect their equipment, issue a party invite, initiate a trade, or challenge a player to a duel. A group leader can promote or remove that player from the group.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PLAYEROPTIONS.target: 右鍵點擊可以顯示與其他玩家互動的特殊指令。你可以查看他們的裝備，發出組隊邀請，開啟交易視窗，或者和其他玩家進行決鬥。一個隊伍的隊長可以提升隊員或者將其從隊伍中移除。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROMOTE.source: Promotes the selected player one rank higher.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PROMOTE.target: 提升所選擇玩家在公會中的會階。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVPFFA.source: You can now attack and be attacked by any player in the game.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_PVPFFA.target: 你現在可以在遊戲中攻擊和被任何玩家攻擊。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_QUESTLOG.source: A list of all the active quests you currently have. You can have up to 20 active quests at one time.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_QUESTLOG.target: 列出你目前進行中的所有任務。同時最多可接受20個任務。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAIDTAB.source: Allows you to view or modify your raid group. Raid groups are groups of more than 5 people used to defeat very difficult challenges at high levels.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RAIDTAB.target: 檢視或者編輯你的大型團隊。團隊是一支由超過5個玩家組成的隊伍，可以用來擊敗高等級的強大敵人。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK.source: Rank is the final result of all the honor system calculations.  Based upon a comparison between your standing for the week versus your current rank, your rank may either rise, fall, or stay the same.  Higher level players rise more quickly in rank (and fall more slowly) than lower level players.  In addition, rank increases more quickly at low ranks than at high ranks.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK.target: 榮譽系統的計算結果將以軍階的形式表現。根據你的本週排名和當前軍階級別的對比，你的軍階級別可能會提高、降低或保持不變。高等級的玩家提升軍階的速度比低等級玩家更快(下降也更慢)。另外，低級軍階提升的速度比高級軍階提升的速度更快。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK_POSITION.source: Your position within the rank. This bar will tell you how close you are to attaining the next rank or falling to the previous rank. This will only be updated each week when ranking is updated.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_RANK_POSITION.target: 你在該階級內的排名位置。這個條棒可以讓你知道距離你進到下一個階級或是退回上一個階級還有多遠。這個條棒會在每週更新階級時才會跟著更新。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_REMOVEFRIEND.source: Removes the selected player from your friends list.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_REMOVEFRIEND.target: 將選定的玩家自你的好友名單之中移除。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SENDMESSAGE.source: Sends a private message to the selected player.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SENDMESSAGE.target: 發送私人訊息給指定的玩家。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SHAREQUEST.source: Shares the selected quest with any nearby party members who are eligible for the quest. Certain quests, such as those granted by items, cannot be shared.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SHAREQUEST.target: 與附近符合任務條件的隊友分享選取的任務。部分任務（例如由物品觸發的任務）無法分享。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SOCIAL.source: Information about other people in the game. You can use the Social window to manage your friends list and ignore list, as well as see who is online.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SOCIAL.target: 遊戲中其他玩家的資訊。你可以使用社交視窗來設定你的好友名單和忽略名單，以及查看有哪些玩家在線上。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SPELLBOOK.source: All of your spells and abilities. To move a spell or ability to your Action Bar, open the Spellbook & Abilities window, left-click that spell or ability, and drag it down to your Action Bar.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_SPELLBOOK.target: 列出你所有的法術與技能。若要放到動作列，請開啟法術書與技能視窗，以滑鼠左鍵按住法術或技能，再拖曳至動作列。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_STOPIGNORE.source: Removes the selected player from your ignore list.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_STOPIGNORE.target: 將選定的玩家從你的忽略名單中移除。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TALENTS.source: The array of talents available to enhance and specialize your character.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_TALENTS.target: 天賦的各種組合選擇能夠增強並專精你的角色。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_DUEL.source: Challenges the selected player to a duel. The first player to reach zero hit points loses the duel.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_DUEL.target: 向選定的玩家提出挑戰，進行決鬥。生命力首先降到零的玩家將會輸去這場決鬥。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FOLLOW.source: Causes you to begin following the selected player. You will automatically continue to follow the player until this auto-follow mode is disrupted.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FOLLOW.target: 開始跟隨選取的玩家，直到自動跟隨模式被中斷。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FREE_FOR_ALL.source: Under free-for-all rules, all group members may loot a monster that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_FREE_FOR_ALL.target: 在自由拾取規則下，協助隊伍擊殺怪物的隊伍隊員都可以撿拾殺死該怪物掉落物品。金錢自動平分。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_GROUP_LOOT.source: Under group loot rules, players take turns looting just like in round-robin with the exception that all group members will be eligible to roll for items over the loot threshold.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_GROUP_LOOT.target: 在隊伍分配規則下，玩家通常使用輪流拾取規則來獲得戰利品，但是品質高於預設級別的物品會經過擲骰子決定歸屬。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INSPECT.source: Inspects any armor and weapons that the selected player has equipped.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INSPECT.target: 觀察選定的玩家所裝備的護甲和武器。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INVITE.source: Invites the selected player to join a group.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_INVITE.target: 邀請選擇的玩家加入隊伍。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LEAVE_PARTY.source: Removes the player from their current party.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LEAVE_PARTY.target: 從玩家目前所在的小隊中移除。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LOOT_THRESHOLD.source: Items of this quality or higher will be able to be rolled on by the group when looted from a monster.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_LOOT_THRESHOLD.target: 從怪物身上拾取戰利品時，品質高於或等於此級別的物品將經過擲骰子決定歸屬。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_MASTER_LOOTER.source: Under master-looter rules, the group leader is the only group member allowed to loot items at or above the threshold. Items below threshold and money are distributed via the round robin rules.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_MASTER_LOOTER.target: 在隊長分配規則下，只有隊伍領袖才能夠撿拾品質等於或高於預設級別的物品。在該級別之下的物品和金錢採用輪流拾取方式分配。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_NEED_BEFORE_GREED.source: Under need-before-greed rules, loot is distributed round-robin style.  Any items over the loot threshold can only be rolled on by group members that can use the item.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_NEED_BEFORE_GREED.target: 在需求優先規則下，玩家通常使用輪流拾取規則來獲得戰利品，但是品質高於預設級別的物品會由能使用該物品的隊友擲骰子決定歸屬。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_ABANDON.source: Abandons your pet, letting it return to the wild. Once you abandon a pet, you can never regain its companionship.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_ABANDON.target: 遺棄你的寵物，讓牠回歸自然。一旦你遺棄了寵物，牠將永遠不再回來。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_PAPERDOLL.source: Information about your pet, including its statistics, spell resistances, and diet.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_PAPERDOLL.target: 你的寵物資訊，包括屬性、法術抗性與食物偏好。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_RENAME.source: Gives your pet a new name that you specify. A pet can only be renamed once.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PET_RENAME.target: 給你的寵物設定一個新的名稱。一個寵物只能被改名一次。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PROMOTE.source: Surrenders your leadership of the group, naming the selected player to succeed you.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_PROMOTE.target: 交出隊伍的領導權，選定的玩家將繼續行使這一職責。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_ROUND_ROBIN.source: Under round-robin rules, group members take turns looting the monsters that they help the group to kill. Money is automatically divided between group members.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_ROUND_ROBIN.target: 在輪流拾取規則下，協助隊伍擊殺怪物的隊伍隊員按照順序撿拾該怪物掉落物品。金錢自動平分。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_TRADE.source: Initiates a trade with the selected player.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_TRADE.target: 與選擇的玩家進行交易。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_UNINVITE.source: Removes the selected player from the group.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_UNIT_UNINVITE.target: 將選定的玩家從隊伍中移除。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WHOTAB.source: Allows you to locate other players in the world.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WHOTAB.target: 找到其他玩家在這個世界中的位置。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WORLDMAP.source: As you explore a zone, more areas of interest will become visible on the world map. You can use left-click to zoom in, or right-click to zoom out.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_WORLDMAP.target: 在你探索一個區域時，重要的地點將會顯示在世界地圖上。你可以使用左鍵放大地圖，右鍵縮小地圖。

NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_XPBAR.source: The amount of experience (XP) you have earned. The color of the XP bar indicates your rest state: light blue for Rested, and purple for Normal. Rested players earn twice the experience they would normally gain from slaying a monster. Characters become less rested when they kill monsters, and more rested by spending time at or logging out at an inn or city.
NEWBIE_TOOLTIP_XPBAR.target: 你所得到的經驗值(XP)。你的經驗條顏色代表了你的休息狀態，藍色代表充分休息，紫色代表正常。充分休息的玩家殺死怪物所獲得的經驗值是正常狀態下的兩倍。殺死怪物將會縮短你的休息狀態。你可以在城市或者旅館中逗留，或者登出以延長你的休息狀態。

NOT_ENOUGH_MANA.source: You don't have enough mana to cast %s.
NOT_ENOUGH_MANA.target: 你沒有足夠的法力來施放%s。

NOT_IN_GROUP.source: You are no longer in a party.

NO_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS_AVAILABLE.source: No equipment slot is available for that item.
NO_EQUIPMENT_SLOTS_AVAILABLE.target: 你沒有可以裝備這件物品的欄位。

NO_RAID_INSTANCES_SAVED.source: You are not saved to any instances
NO_RAID_INSTANCES_SAVED.target: 你在任何副本中的進度都未保存

ONLY_EMPTY_BAGS.source: Only empty bags can be picked up!

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ALWAYS_SHOW_MULTIBARS.source: Check this option to always display extra actionbars.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ALWAYS_SHOW_MULTIBARS.target: 勾選此選項後，額外的快捷列欄位將總是被顯示出來。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ASSIST_ATTACK.source: Automatically attack a target when you acquire it by using "/assist".
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ASSIST_ATTACK.target: 自動攻擊使用「/assist」指令選定的目標。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_FOLLOW_SPEED.source: Adjust the camera movement speed in Always and Smart following styles.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_FOLLOW_SPEED.target: 調整總是跟隨和智慧跟隨模式下的鏡頭移動速度。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_JOIN_GUILD_CHANNEL.source: Check this option to automatically join the Guild Recruitment chat channel based upon whether or not you are in a guild.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_JOIN_GUILD_CHANNEL.target: 勾選此選項以自動加入公會招募對話頻道，取決於你是否已加入公會。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_QUEST_WATCH.source: Quests are automatically watched for 5 minutes when you achieve a quest objective.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_QUEST_WATCH.target: 完成任務目標時，該任務會被自動追蹤5分鐘。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST.source: When this is enabled, friendly target spells that you cast while you have a non friendly target or no target will automatically be self cast. This function has a hotkey that can be assigned.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_AUTO_SELF_CAST.target: 啟用後，在沒有友方目標時施放的友方法術會自動對自己施放。此功能可以綁定按鍵。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA1.source: Set the camera to stay where placed, except when your character is moving.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA1.target: 鏡頭保持在你放置的位置，除非角色正在移動。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA2.source: Set the camera to always prefer being behind your character.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA2.target: 設定鏡頭，使你的視角總是處於角色的後方。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_ALWAYS.source: Set the camera to always prefer being behind your character.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CAMERA_ALWAYS.target: 設定鏡頭，使你的視角總是處於角色的後方。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CHAT_BUBBLES.source: Shows /say and /yell text in speech bubbles above characters' heads.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CHAT_BUBBLES.target: 在角色頭頂上顯示「/說」指令和「/大喊」指令的文字泡泡。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CHAT_LOCKED.source: Locks all chat windows so they cannot accidentally be altered.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CHAT_LOCKED.target: 鎖定所有對話視窗，這樣它們就不會被誤改了。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CINEMATIC_SUBTITLES.source: Enables subtitles during the intro cinematic.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_LOCKED.source: Sets the camera to always be aligned with your character when changing direction with click-to-move.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_LOCKED.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下，視角永遠與你的行進方向一致。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_NEVER.source: Sets the camera to not move when changing direction with click-to-move.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_NEVER.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下改變方向時，不會跟著改變你的視角。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_SMART.source: Sets the camera to follow your character after a brief delay when changing direction with click-to-move. (Recommended Mode)
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICKCAMERA_SMART.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下改變方向時稍作延遲，然後跟隨你的角色。(推薦模式)

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA1.source: Sets the camera to follow your character after a brief delay when changing direction with click-to-move. (Recommended Mode)
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA1.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下改變方向時稍作延遲，然後跟隨你的角色。(推薦模式)

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA2.source: Sets the camera to always be aligned with your character when changing direction with click-to-move.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA2.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下，視角永遠與你的行進方向一致。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA3.source: Sets the camera to not move when changing direction with click-to-move.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA3.target: 設定鏡頭，使其在點擊移動模式下改變方向時，不會跟著改變你的視角。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA_STYLE.source: Determines the way the camera follows the player while in Click-to-Move mode.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_CAMERA_STYLE.target: 決定點擊移動模式下的鏡頭跟隨方式。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_TO_MOVE.source: Use mouse clicks to move your character to destinations.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_CLICK_TO_MOVE.target: 使用滑鼠右鍵來移動你的角色至點擊的地點。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_MODE.source: Sets the direction that combat text scrolls.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_MODE.target: 設定戰鬥文字捲動的方向。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SCROLL_DOWN.source: Scroll combat text down instead of up.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS.source: Shows a message when the player gains an aura.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURAS.target: 玩家獲得光環時顯示提示。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURA_FAD.source: Shows a message when an aura fades from the player.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_AURA_FAD.target: 當光環從玩家身上消失時顯示一個訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_S.source: Shows a message when you enter or leave combat.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBAT_S.target: 在你進入或離開戰鬥時顯示一個訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBO_PO.source: Shows the number of combo points you have each time you acquire a new one.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_COMBO_PO.target: 每獲得新的連擊點數時顯示你所有的連擊點數。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_DODGE_PA.source: Shows attacks against you that dodge, parry, or miss.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_DODGE_PA.target: 顯示被你閃躲、招架、或未擊中的攻擊。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_FRIENDLY.source: Shows the name of a friendly caster when they cast a heal spell on you.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_FRIENDLY.target: 當友方施法者對你施放一個治療法術時顯示他們的名稱。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_HONOR_GA.source: Shows the honor you gain from killing other players.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_HONOR_GA.target: 顯示你殺死其他玩家所獲得的榮譽點數。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_LOW_HEAL.source: Shows a message when you fall below 20% mana or health.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_LOW_HEAL.target: 當你剩下低於20%的法力或生命力時顯示訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_MANA.source: Shows all instant gains of mana, rage, and energy.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_MANA.target: 顯示所有瞬間獲得的法力、怒氣和能量。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REACTIVE.source: Shows when reactive class specific abilities and spells become available (e.g. Overpower for warriors).
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REACTIVE.target: 當觸發式職業特殊技能和法術可以使用時顯示(如戰士的壓制)。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REPUTATI.source: Shows a message when the player gains or loses reputation with a faction.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_REPUTATI.target: 在玩家獲得或失去某陣營聲望時顯示一個訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_RESISTAN.source: Shows when you resist taking damage from attacks or spells.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_COMBAT_TEXT_SHOW_RESISTAN.target: 當你抵抗了攻擊或法術造成的傷害時顯示訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DEATH_EFFECT.source: Uncheck to disable glowing effect while in ghost form. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_DEATH_EFFECT.target: 取消勾選這裡會取消鬼魂狀態下的泛光效果。關閉這個選項有時可以提高效能。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_SPAM_FILTER.source: Disables spam filtering on chat text.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_DISABLE_SPAM_FILTER.target: 停用聊天文字的垃圾訊息過濾。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ALL_SHADERS.target: 開啟所有像素著色效果。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ALL_SOUND.source: Enables or disables all game sound.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ALL_SOUND.target: 開啟或關閉所有遊戲聲音。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_EMOTE_SOUNDS.source: Toggles emote sounds on and off.

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ERROR_SPEECH.source: Enables speech from errors (e.g. "Target out of range").
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_ERROR_SPEECH.target: 開啟錯誤提示語音(例如「目標太遠」)。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MUSIC_LOOPING.source: Enable to continuously play background music.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_MUSIC_LOOPING.target: 持續不斷地播放背景音樂。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOUND_AT_CHARACTER.source: Listen to sound from the character's point of view rather than the camera.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENABLE_SOUND_AT_CHARACTER.target: 將聲源接收位置設定為來自玩家角色所在位置，而非鏡頭位置。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENVIRONMENT_DETAIL.source: Controls how far you can see objects. Decrease to improve performance.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_ENVIRONMENT_DETAIL.target: 控制物件的可視距離。降低這個數值可以提高效能。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FARCLIP.source: Changes how far you can see terrain. Decrease to improve performance.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_FARCLIP.target: 改變能看到地形的距離。降低可提升效能。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOLLOW_TERRAIN.source: Automatically change the camera angle based on the terrain. If your character climbs a slope, the camera will rotate upwards; if you descend, it will rotate downwards.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_FOLLOW_TERRAIN.target: 根據地形自動調整鏡頭。如果你的角色在爬坡，鏡頭會轉向上; 如果你的角色在往下走，則鏡頭會轉向下。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_FULL_SCREEN_GLOW.source: Enables a full screen effect that softens edges and lighting. Disabling this can sometimes improve performance.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_FULL_SCREEN_GLOW.target: 開啟全螢幕柔化和光影效果。關閉這個選項有時可以提高效能。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEFIELD_DESELECT.source: Checking this will prevent the deselection of targets by clicking on the gamefield.  Targets can only be cleared by pressing escape or clicking another target.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_GAMEFIELD_DESELECT.target: 勾選此選項可以防止點選遊戲主畫面時取消已選取的目標。你將只能使用ESC鍵或是點選其他目標來取消已選定的目標。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_GUILDMEMBER_ALERT.source: Show a message when your guild members login and logout.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_GUILDMEMBER_ALERT.target: 當你的公會會員登入或者退出遊戲時顯示訊息。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HEAD_BOB.source: Simulate head bobbing when in first-person perspective.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_HEAD_BOB.target: 在第一人稱視角時，模擬角色的頭部晃動。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_OUTDOOR_WORLD_STATE.source: Checking this will hide the interface for tracking zone wide objectives.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_OUTDOOR_WORLD_STATE.target: 將此選項打勾會隱藏追蹤區域目標。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_PARTY_INTERFACE.source: Click this to hide your party's portraits and health bars.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_HIDE_PARTY_INTERFACE.target: 勾選此項以隱藏你隊伍的頭像及生命條。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_MOUSE.source: Invert the way that the mouse affects camera pitch.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_INVERT_MOUSE.target: 滑鼠移動方向與鏡頭改變方向相反。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_ACTIONBAR.source: Prevents the user from picking up/dragging spells on the action bar. This function can be bound to a function key in the keybindings interface.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOCK_ACTIONBAR.target: 使玩家無法拖曳快捷列上的技能圖示。這項功能可以透過按鍵設定介面來設定對應的快捷鍵。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOG_PERIODIC_EFFECTS.source: Display damage caused by periodic effects such as Rend and Shadow Word: Pain.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_LOG_PERIODIC_EFFECTS.target: 顯示撕裂和暗言術:痛之類的週期性傷害效果數值。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAX_FOLLOW_DIST.source: Adjust the maximum distance the camera will follow behind you.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_MAX_FOLLOW_DIST.target: 調整鏡頭跟隨在角色後的最遠距離。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_LOOK_SPEED.source: Adjust the speed at which you turn the camera when using mouse look.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_LOOK_SPEED.target: 調整使用滑鼠改變鏡頭時的移動速度。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY.source: Adjust the speed at which the mouse cursor moves.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_MOUSE_SENSITIVITY.target: 調整滑鼠游標的移動速度。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_PARTY_CHAT_BUBBLES.source: Shows party chat text in speech bubbles above party members' heads.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_PARTY_CHAT_BUBBLES.target: 在隊友頭頂上顯示隊伍對話的文字泡泡。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_NAMEPLATES.source: Toggles displaying of name plates on your pets, totems, and guardians.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_NAMEPLATES.target: 切換你的寵物、圖騰和守護者的名條。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_SPELL_DAMAGE.source: Show spell damage caused by your pet.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_PET_SPELL_DAMAGE.target: 顯示你的寵物造成的法術傷害

OPTION_TOOLTIP_PHONG_SHADING.source: Enable this option for smooth lighting across characters.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_PHONG_SHADING.target: 開啟這個選項可以平滑角色光線表現。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY.source: Check to show chat windows immediately upon mouseover.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_REMOVE_CHAT_DELAY.target: 選擇後當滑鼠移動到對話視窗之後視窗會立即顯示。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_ARC.source: Scrolls the text in arcs away from the player.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_ARC.target: 將文字以弧形捲離玩家。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_DOWN.source: Scrolls combat text towards the bottom of the screen.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_DOWN.target: 將戰鬥文字往螢幕下方捲動。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_UP.source: Scrolls combat text towards the top of the screen.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SCROLL_UP.target: 將戰鬥文字往螢幕上方捲動。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_BUFF_DURATION.source: Toggle text counters for buff durations on and off.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_BUFF_DURATION.target: 切換增益效果的持續時間。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CLOAK.source: Uncheck this box to hide your character's cloak.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_CLOAK.target: 取消勾選這個選項來隱藏角色的披風。

OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT.source: Checking this will enable additional combat messages to appear in the playfield.
OPTION_TOOLTIP_SHOW_COMBAT_TEXT.target: 勾選此選項讓更多的戰鬥訊息出現在遊戲中。

Raids are groups of more than 5 people and are typically used to defeat unique challenges at high levels.

|cffffffff- Raid members cannot earn credit toward most non-raid quests. Specifically, they will not receive non-raid quest credit for killing creatures or collecting items.

- Raids grant substantially less experience for defeating monsters than normal groups.

- Raids allow you to overcome challenges that might otherwise be nearly impossible.|r

團隊是超過5個人的隊伍，這是為了擊敗高等級的特定挑戰而準備的大型隊伍模式。

does not affect Critical Hit chances at all. Strength does
not improve your chance to block, but rather the amount
blocked when you succeed. This amount is determined in

VERBAL_HARASSMENT_DESCRIPTION.source: Verbal abuse from one player to another.
VERBAL_HARASSMENT_DESCRIPTION.target: 一個玩家對於另外一個玩家的語言攻擊。如果語言中包含褻瀆的內容或者非法的內容，那麼這樣的語言可以被認為是一種騷擾。

VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT1.source: Below are some tips to deal with verbal harassment:
VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT1.target: 以下是一些對付語言騷擾的方法:

VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT2.source: Ask the harassing player to stop, and place him/her on your ignore list.
VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT2.target: 將這個玩家加入你的忽略名單中並要求他/她停止騷擾。

VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT3.source: Ensure that you do not instigate further harassment.
VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT3.target: 保證你不再遭受更多的騷擾。

VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT4.source: Immediately report all language that is racist, extremely sexual, and/or violent; this type of language is always considered harassment.
VERBAL_HARASSMENT_TEXT4.target: 立即舉報所有有關種族歧視、性或暴力的言語:這類言論一向都被視為騷擾。

VOICEMACRO_13_Gn_3_FEMALE.source: I'll always treasure our time together.
VOICEMACRO_13_Gn_3_FEMALE.target: 我會一直珍惜我們在一起的時光的。

VOICEMACRO_13_Or_2.target: 願你的劍真的如此鋒利。

VOICEMACRO_13_Ta_2.source: May the wind be at your back.

VOICEMACRO_15_Ta_2_FEMALE.source: It is not meant to be.

VOICEMACRO_16_Dw_3.source: May your generosity be returned to you a hundred fold.
VOICEMACRO_16_Dw_3.target: 願你再次表現的如此慷慨而且其程度可以是現在的一百倍。

VOICEMACRO_16_Dw_3_FEMALE.source: May your generosity be returned to you one hundred fold.
VOICEMACRO_16_Dw_3_FEMALE.target: 願你的慷慨善行可以得到一百倍的回報。

VOICEMACRO_16_Gn_2.source: Allow me to express my deepest thanks.
VOICEMACRO_16_Gn_2.target: 請允許我表示我深深的感謝。

VOICEMACRO_16_Ta_3.source: May your ancestors forever guard your path.
VOICEMACRO_16_Ta_3.target: 願你的祖先會永遠指引你前進。

VOICEMACRO_17_Hu_0.target: 我一直都會樂意幫助你的。

VOICEMACRO_17_Hu_1.source: Nothing you wouldn't have done for me.

VOICEMACRO_17_Sc_2_FEMALE.source: This doesn't mean I like you.

VOICEMACRO_17_Ta_1.target: 我一直都會樂意幫助你的。

VOICEMACRO_17_Ta_1_FEMALE.target: 我一直都會樂意幫助你的。

VOICEMACRO_17_Tr_2.source: You scratch my back, I scratch yours.
VOICEMACRO_17_Tr_2.target: 你幫我抓背，我幫你抓背。

VOICEMACRO_18_Sc_2_FEMALE.target: 好吧，你難道不感到幸運嗎。

VOICEMACRO_18_Tr_2.source: They will speak of your exploits for generations.
VOICEMACRO_18_Tr_2.target: 他們會世代頌揚你的發現。

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_0.source: Enough of this chit chat.  Let's get to it, then.
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_0.target: 廢話夠了。讓我們開始吧。

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_1.source: You'd like to run your hands through my beard, wouldn't you?
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_1.target: 你是不是想要摸摸我的鬍子，是不是?

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_1_FEMALE.source: I'll have you know I can flatten steel with my thighs.
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_1_FEMALE.target: 我要讓你知道我用大腿就能把鋼鐵碾平。

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_2.source: Let's get on with it, then.  I've got a quest to do in fifteen minutes.

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_2_FEMALE.source: I'd like to see you in a kilt.

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_3.source: You look pretty.  I like your hair.  Here's your drink.  Are you ready now?
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_3.target: 你很漂亮。我喜歡你的頭髮。這是你的飲料。你現在準備好了沒有?

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_3_FEMALE.source: I won't fall for any bad pickup line.  You've got to try two or three, at least.

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_4.source: Where are you from?  Not that it matters.
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_4.target: 你從哪裡來的?那並不重要。

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_4_FEMALE.source: Enough with your flirting.  I know you think all Dwarven women look the same.
VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_4_FEMALE.target: 不要再對我甜言蜜語了，我知道你認為所有的矮人女性看起來都一個樣子。

VOICEMACRO_19_Dw_5.source: I must be asleep, cause you're a dream come true.  Also, I'm slightly damp.

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_0.source: I have a number of inventions I'd like to show you back at my place.

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_1.source: Everyone keeps talking about beer goggles.  I can't find the plans for them anywhere.

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_1_FEMALE.source: At this time I think you should purchase me an alcoholic beverage and engage in diminutive conversation with me in hopes of establishing a rapport.

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_2.source: I like large posteriors, and I cannot prevaricate.

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_2_FEMALE.source: Your ability to form a complete sentence is a plus.
VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_2_FEMALE.target: 可以完全組成句子的能力會讓你加分。

VOICEMACRO_19_Gn_3_FEMALE.source: I do not find you completely disagreeable.

VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_0_FEMALE.source: You've got me all a flutter.

VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_1.source: If I said you had a good body, would you hold it against me?

VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_1_FEMALE.source: My turn offs are rude people, mean people, and people who aren't nice.

VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_4.source: Are you tired, cause you've been running through my mind all day.

VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_5.source: Your tag's showing.  It says, "Made in heaven."
VOICEMACRO_19_Hu_5.target: 你的標籤跑出來了。上面寫著「上帝製造。」

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_0.source: You're an Emerald Dream come true.
VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_0.target: 你簡直好像是翡翠夢境變成了真實一樣。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_0_FEMALE.source: If I wasn't purple, you'd see I was blushing.
VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_0_FEMALE.target: 如果我不是紫色的話，你會看到我臉紅。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_1.source: I hope you're not afraid of snakes.

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_1_FEMALE.target: 當然，我的東西都相當具有穿透力。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_2.source: Baby, I'm mortal now.  Time's a wasting.

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_2_FEMALE.source: I'm the type of girl my mother warned me about.
VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_2_FEMALE.target: 我是我媽媽警告過的那種女孩。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_3_FEMALE.source: There's nothing like sleeping in the forest under the moonlight.
VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_3_FEMALE.target: 沒有什麼比得上在月光沐浴下在森林裡睡覺的事情了。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ni_4.source: Wanna bring out the animal in me?

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_0.source: That armor looks good on you.  It would also look good on my floor.
VOICEMACRO_19_Or_0.target: 你穿的護甲不錯。如果它能躺在我的地板上的話會更好。

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_0_FEMALE.source: You had me at zug zug.
VOICEMACRO_19_Or_0_FEMALE.target: 你的嘖嘖聲已經擄獲了我的心。

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_1.source: This is true love.  Do you think this happens every day?
VOICEMACRO_19_Or_1.target: 這就是真愛。你認為這樣的事情天天發生嗎?

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_2.source: You have six different smiles; one for when you're angry, one for when you tear flesh, one for when you chew flesh, one for when you loot bodies, one for when you skin game, and one for when you want to kill something.

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_2_FEMALE.source: I like men who aren't afraid to cry; cry uncle.

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_3.source: I love you like a fat kid loves cake.

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_3_FEMALE.target: 你可以的。讓我們出發吧。

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_4.source: Lady, from the moment I see you I... I did not expect to get this far.
VOICEMACRO_19_Or_4.target: 女士，當我看到你的時候我……我沒有想到我們會如此深入的交往。

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_5.source: Um, you look like a lady.

VOICEMACRO_19_Or_5_FEMALE.source: Let's not ruin this moment with chit chat.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_0.source: I don't smell that bad for a dead dude, do I?

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_1.source: You have beautiful skin; no maggot holes at all.
VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_1.target: 你的皮膚很漂亮;一個蟲眼也沒有。

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_1_FEMALE.source: One good thing about being dead, biological clock seems to have stopped.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_2.source: If rot was hot, I'd be a volcano.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_2_FEMALE.source: Us Undead girls really know how to have a good time because, after all, what's the worst thing that could happen?

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_3.source: Once you go dead, you never go back.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_3_FEMALE.source: I can't wait to suck the juice out of your eyeballs.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_4.source: Check my breath.  Is it bad enough for you?

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_4_FEMALE.source: I don't care that much about romance.  I fell in love before, and look what happened to me.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_5.source: Don't mind the drool.  It's just embalming fluid.

VOICEMACRO_19_Sc_5_FEMALE.source: I don't need to get funky.  I'm already there.

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_0_FEMALE.source: I'm tired of the same old bull.

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_1_FEMALE.source: I want a man with soft hands.  Preferably four of them.

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_2_FEMALE.source: I've got big soulful eyes, long eyelashes, and a wet tongue.  What more could a guy want?

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_4.source: You know, older bulls really only have one function.
VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_4.target: 你要知道，年長的公牛只有一個功能。

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_4_FEMALE.source: Wanna see some good clog dancing?
VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_4_FEMALE.target: 想要看看正宗的木屐舞嗎?

VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_5.source: Are you comfortable with complicated machinery?
VOICEMACRO_19_Ta_5.target: 你對複雜的機器感覺還頭痛不?

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_0.source: Want some of my jungle love?
VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_0.target: 想要一些我的狂野之愛嗎?

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_0_FEMALE.source: I know.  My natural beauty is intimidating.

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_1.source: We Trolls mate for life.  'Course, we believe in frequent reincarnation.

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_1_FEMALE.source: When enraged, and in heat, a female Troll can mate over eighty times in one night.  Be you prepared?

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_2.target: 你看起來相當相當美味。

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_2_FEMALE.source: Aren't you going to axe me out?

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_3.source: I hope you're well rested.  You're going to need your strength.

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_3_FEMALE.source: I won't bite you where it shows.
VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_3_FEMALE.target: 我不會咬你露在外面的地方的。

VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_4_FEMALE.source: You're the type I'd like to sink my teeth into.
VOICEMACRO_19_Tr_4_FEMALE.target: 你是那種我恨之入骨的人。

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_0.source: Hi ho, hi ho... uh... second verse, same as the first.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_0_FEMALE.source: No, they're not real, but thanks for noticing.
VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_0_FEMALE.target: 不，它們不是真的，但是感謝你注意到了它們。

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_1_FEMALE.source: I don't like to be underground.  It reminds me of death.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_2.source: Oh, I'm having a wardrobe malfunction.  Oh, there's my hammer.
VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_2.target: 哦，我的衣櫥有點問題。哦，那是我的錘子。

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_2_FEMALE.source: I like my ale like I like my men; dark and rich.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_3.source: I don't have a drinking problem.  I drink, I get drunk, I fall down, no problem.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_3_FEMALE.source: It's like my father always used to say, "Shut up, and get out."

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_4.source: I don't drink anymore.  'Course, I don't drink any less, either.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_4_FEMALE.source: My uncle has brass balls.  No, really!
VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_4_FEMALE.target: 我的叔叔有黃銅作的球。不，這是真的!

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_5.source: I like my beer like I like my women; stout and bitter.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_5_FEMALE.source: I give myself a Dutch oven pedicure every night.  I've got no foot fungus at all.  My toes are pristine.

VOICEMACRO_20_Dw_6.source: Oh, I'm just a social drinker.  Every time someone says, "I'll have a drink", I say, "So shall I."

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_0.source: You know, I really wish I had a garden where I could put a couple of human statues.
VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_0.target: 你要知道，我希望自己有個花園可以放一些人形雕塑。

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_0_FEMALE.source: I apologize profusely for any inconvenience my murderous rampage may have caused.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_1.source: I think that last vendor short changed me.  Oh, that was a bad one.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_1_FEMALE.source: I've discovered that getting pummeled by a blunt weapon can be quite painful.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_2.source: I do hope to find some interesting gadgets around here.  I do love tinkering with things.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_2_FEMALE.source: You know, squirrels can be deadly when cornered.
VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_2_FEMALE.target: 你要知道，如果被逼到絕路，松鼠也會是致命的。

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_3.source: I had an idea for a device that you could put small pieces of bread in to cook, but in the end I really didn't think there would be much of a market for it.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_3_FEMALE.source: Some day, I hope to find the nuggets on a chicken.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_4.source: I'd like to give a shout out to my boys in Gnomeregan.  Keeping it real Big-T, Snoop-Pup, and Little Dees.  Y'all are short, but you're real, baby.

VOICEMACRO_20_Gn_5.source: I look bigger in those mirrors where things look bigger.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_0.source: Cover for me.  I gotta whiz behind a tree.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_0_FEMALE.source: Why does everyone automatically assume I know tailoring and cooking?

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_1.source: So, an Orc walks into a bar with a parrot on his shoulder.  The bartender says, "Hey, where'd you get that?"  The parrot says, "Durotar.  They got 'em all over the place."

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_1_FEMALE.source: Do you ever feel like you're not in charge of your own destiny, like you're being controlled by an invisible hand?

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_2.source: A duck walked into an apothecary and he said, "Give me some chapstick, and put it on my bill."

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_2_FEMALE.source: Sometimes, I have trouble CONTROLLING THE VOLUME OF MY VOICE!

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_3.source: How does a Tauren hide in a cherry tree?  He paints his hooves red.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_3_FEMALE.source: I like to fart in the tub.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_4.source: A guy walked up to me and said, "I'm a teepee, I'm a wigwam, I'm a teepee, I'm a wigwam."  I said, "Relax, man, you're too tense."

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_4_FEMALE.source: Me and my girlfriends exchange clothes all the time.  We're all the same size.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_5.source: So, I have this idea for a great movie.  It's about two Gnomes who find a bracelet of power, and they have to take it to the Burning Steppes and cast it into The Cauldron.  They form the Brotherhood of the Bracelet.  Along the way, they're trailed by a murloc named Gottom who's obsessed with the bracelet, and nine bracelet bogeymen.  It could be a three parter called "Ruler of the Bracelet".  The first part would be called "The Brotherhood of the Bracelet", followed by "A Couple of Towers", with the climactic ending called "Hey, the King's Back".

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_5_FEMALE.source: I can't find anywhere to get my nails done.

VOICEMACRO_20_Hu_6_FEMALE.source: I can't wait till this quest is done, and I can look for another Garibaldi artifact.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_0.source: Last night I went to an awesome stag party.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_0_FEMALE.source: You know I have to keep moving at night or I'll disappear.
VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_0_FEMALE.target: 你知道我在晚上要不斷移動，否則我會消失的。

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_1.source: You know those Ancient Protectors in Darnassas?  They're not that old.
VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_1.target: 你知道達納蘇斯的古樹保衛者嗎? 它們並不是那麼古老。

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_1_FEMALE.source: Actually, I'm more of a morning elf.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_2.source: Man, I was halfway through the Emerald Dream when I had to pee.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_2_FEMALE.source: You know, Wisps are actually pretty useful for personal hygiene.
VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_2_FEMALE.target: 你要知道，幽光對於個人衛生很有用處。

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_3.source: Is that thing sharp?  Could that thing cut me?  I'm not immortal now, you know.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_3_FEMALE.source: I think that guys just use the Emerald Dream as an excuse to avoid calling me back.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_4.source: I don't know about you, but I can't understand a thing those Wisps say.  I usually just nod.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_4_FEMALE.source: Oh, I'm dancing again.  I hope all your friends are enjoying the show.
VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_4_FEMALE.target: 哦，我又在跳舞了。我希望你所有的朋友都喜歡這個表演。

VOICEMACRO_20_Ni_7.source: I don't mind the Gnomes, but I'm always worried about tripping over one.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_0.source: I will crush and destroy and... ooo... shiny...

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_0_FEMALE.source: Get between me and my food, and you'll lose a hand.
VOICEMACRO_20_Or_0_FEMALE.target: 如果你敢擋在我和我的食物中間的話，你會損失一隻手。

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_1_FEMALE.source: I have no respect for people with small piercings.  I say go full hog.  Put a spear through your head.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_2.source: Man, dawg, you know, it's like I'm feeling you, but I'm not feeling you, you know?

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_2_FEMALE.source: I feel very feminine, and I'll beat the crap out of anyone who disagrees.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_3.source: I come from the Orcs.  We eat with spoons and forks.  We love to eat our pork.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_3_FEMALE.source: What's estrogen?  Can you eat it?
VOICEMACRO_20_Or_3_FEMALE.target: 什麼是女性動情激素?可以吃嗎?

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_4_FEMALE.source: I need to get my chest waxed again.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_5.source: Stop poking me!  Well, that was okay.

VOICEMACRO_20_Or_5_FEMALE.source: Man, I think that boar meat's coming back on me.  I gotta hit the can.  Anyone have a hearthstone?

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_0.source: I can't stand the smell of Orcs.

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_0_FEMALE.source: I'd paint my toenails, but I'm not sure where they fell off.

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_1_FEMALE.source: Yes, they're real.  They're not mine, but they're real.
VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_1_FEMALE.target: 是的，他們是真的。他們不是我的，但是他們是真的。

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_2.source: Roses are gray, violets are gray.  I'm dead and color blind.

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_3.source: Hey diddle diddle, the mucus and the spittle, the corpse sank in the lagoon.  The murloc said, "Ahhh..." to see such a sight, and the Dwarf spanked the baboon.

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_4.source: Anyone have any odorant?  Either "wet dog", "fresh garbage", or "low tide" would do.

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_4_FEMALE.source: You know, once you're dead, nothing smells bad anymore.  Rotten eggs?  No problem.  Dead fish?  Like a spring breeze.
VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_4_FEMALE.target: 你要知道，一旦你死了，就沒有什麼不好聞的東西了。腐臭的雞蛋?沒有問題。死魚?那好像一股清新的微風。

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_5_FEMALE.source: You don't need deodorant when you don't have any armpits.
VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_5_FEMALE.target: 如果你沒有腋窩的話既不需要任何除臭劑。

VOICEMACRO_20_Sc_7_FEMALE.source: I heard a knee slapper once, and skipped my kneecap right across a lake.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_0.source: Mess with the bull, you get the horns.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_0_FEMALE.source: In my native tongue, my name means Dances with Tassels.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_1_FEMALE.source: I once laughed so hard, I milked all over the floor.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_2.source: Homogenized?  No way.  I like the ladies.

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_2_FEMALE.target: 來自莫高雷的快樂牛頭人

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_3.source: You know, Taurens are born hunters.  You ever see a Tauren catch a salmon out of a stream?  It really is quite exciting.  And, have you ever seen a Tauren stalk a python?  'Course you haven't.  That's because Taurens are so adept at blending in with their surroundings.
VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_3.target: 你要知道，牛頭人天生就是獵人。你看見過牛頭人從小溪中抓鮭魚的場景沒有?這非常令人興奮。還有，你見過牛頭人扼住大蟒的情景沒有?當然你沒有。那是因為牛頭人善於融入周圍的環境。

VOICEMACRO_20_Ta_3_FEMALE.source: You know how hard it is to get your groove on with the spirit of your great grandmother looking over you?

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_0_FEMALE.source: Strong halitosis be but one of my feminine traits.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_1.source: I like my women dumpy and droopy with halitosis.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_1_FEMALE.source: I feel pretty, oh so pretty (spit).

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_2.source: I got a shrunken head.  I just came out of the pool.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_2_FEMALE.source: I got all this and personality, too.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_3_FEMALE.source: The way to a man's heart be through his stomach, but I go through the rib cage.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_4.source: I kill two dwarves in the morning, I kill two dwarves at night.  I kill two dwarves in the afternoon, and then I feel alright. I kill two dwarves in time of peace and two in time of war. I kill two dwarves before I kill two dwarves, and then I kill two more.

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_4_FEMALE.source: If cannibalism be wrong, I don't want to be right.
VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_4_FEMALE.target: 如果食屍是錯誤的話，那我寧願一錯再錯。

VOICEMACRO_20_Tr_5.source: I heard if you cut off an extremity, it'll regenerate a little bigger.  Don't believe it.

VOICEMACRO_2_Tr_1.target: 現在，讓我們大開殺戒吧!

VOICEMACRO_2_Tr_1_FEMALE.source: We bring the pain to them!

VOICEMACRO_4_Gn_0_FEMALE.source: Can I get some help over here?

VOICEMACRO_4_Gn_1_FEMALE.source: Hey, help me attack over here!

VOICEMACRO_8_Gn_1.target: 你能幫忙治療我一下嗎?

VOICEMACRO_8_Gn_1_FEMALE.target: 你能幫忙治療我一下嗎?

VOICEMACRO_8_Tr_0_FEMALE.source: I be in a bad way!

VOICEMACRO_8_Tr_2.source: I be in a bad way.

BILLING_FIXED_LASTDAY.source: Your fixed plan account will expire in less than a day. Please go to the billing pages and purchase another plan.
BILLING_FIXED_LASTDAY.target: 你的固定計畫帳號將在一天內到期。請購買更多的遊戲時間以進行遊戲。

BILLING_GAMEROOM_EXPIRE.source:

Please contact the manager on duty in your IGR.
BILLING_GAMEROOM_EXPIRE.target:
使用中的IGR帳戶即將到期。一旦到期時，你將會被強制退出遊戲。
請跟你的IGR主管聯繫。

BILLING_HAS_FALLBACK_PAYMENT.source: There may be additional time on your account from other payment plans.
BILLING_HAS_FALLBACK_PAYMENT.target: 你的帳號中可能還有透過其他付費方式取得的額外遊戲時間。

BILLING_IGR_USAGE.source: You are currently using an IGR usage plan. Your personal time will not be deducted.

BILLING_IGR_USAGE_TIME_LEFT_30_MINS.source: This IGR usage plan has 30 minutes or less of play time left on it.
BILLING_IGR_USAGE_TIME_LEFT_30_MINS.target: 這個IGR使用計畫剩下30分鐘或更少。

BILLING_TEXT1.source: You are using a subscription to play this account.  You will be notified when you have one day or less on your account.
BILLING_TEXT1.target: 你的帳號目前採用預付費機制。當這個帳號的遊戲時間少於一天時，我們會通知您。

BILLING_TEXT2.source: You are currently in your free trial period and will not be charged.
BILLING_TEXT2.target: 你目前正處於免費遊戲期間，不會被收取任何費用。

BILLING_TEXT3.source: You are using a personal fixed plan.  Your plan will expire in %s.
BILLING_TEXT3.target: 你正在使用個人的固定計畫。你的遊戲時間會在%s後到期。

BILLING_TEXT4.source: You are now using your personal time to play this account.  You currently have %d minutes left on the current subscription.  You will be notified 30 minutes before you will run out of time.
BILLING_TEXT4.target: 你目前正在使用你的個人時間來進行遊戲。你現在的帳號中還剩餘%d分鐘。你會在遊戲時間用完前的30分鐘收到通知。

CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION_TEXT.source: A realm category refers to its geographical location. Players should generally choose the realm that is closest to them. This ensures the lowest amount of latency and provides the best possible game experience.
CATEGORY_DESCRIPTION_TEXT.target: 伺服器分類是指其所在的地理位置。我們建議玩家選擇距離他們最近的伺服器，以獲得最低的延遲和最好的遊戲體驗。

GAMETYPE_RPPVP_TEXT.source: These realms have strict naming conventions and behavior rules for players interested in immersing themselves as a character in a fantasy-based world.  They also focus on player combat; you are always at risk of being attacked by opposing players except in starting areas and cities.
GAMETYPE_RPPVP_TEXT.target: 這些伺服器有嚴格的命名限制和行為規範，適合那些喜歡在遊戲世界中扮演虛擬角色的玩家。這些玩家同時也特別專注於玩家間的戰鬥;除了在一開始的地區及城市以外，你隨時都有被敵對玩家攻擊的風險。

REALM_DESCRIPTION_TEXT.source: A realm is a discrete game world that exists only for the players within it. You can interact with all the players in your realm, but not with players in other realms. You cannot move your characters between realms. Realms are differentiated by location and play style.
REALM_DESCRIPTION_TEXT.target: 伺服器是獨立的遊戲世界，只供該伺服器的玩家遊玩。你可與同伺服器的所有玩家互動，但無法與其他伺服器玩家互動，也不能將角色移往其他伺服器。伺服器依地區與玩法區分。
